metadata.problemStatement: SIH 2026 Problem Statement SIH26130 — Efficiency in Streamlining Industrial Approvals
metadata.disclaimer: Illustrative Demonstration Ruleset / Synthetic Data for Hackathon Evaluation. Not an official statutory repository.

profiles.name: Apex Precision Engineering
profiles.location: Chakan Industrial Area, Phase II, Pune
profiles.description: High-precision CNC turning, metal component washing, and surface finishing facility requiring dedicated industrial effluent containment and high-tension electrical sanction.

profiles.name: Greenleaf Agro-Processing
profiles.description: Grain sorting, dehydration, and packaging unit with organic wash-water discharge under green regulatory threshold.

profiles.name: Voltix Microelectronics
profiles.description: Cleanroom electronic board assembly, zero effluent discharge, non-polluting dry assembly operations.

documents.title: Approved Site Layout & Contour Plan
documents.description: Master site boundary blueprint showing entry/exit gates, setbacks, and utility corridors certified by a Registered Architect.

documents.title: Land Title Deed / MIDC Industrial Lease Agreement
documents.description: Registered 95-year industrial lease deed along with possession receipt and survey demarcation certificate.

documents.title: Detailed Project Report (DPR) & Machinery Schedule
documents.description: List of capital plant equipment, installed HP rating, raw material flow diagram, and manufacturing process description.

documents.title: Structural Stability Certificate (Chartered Engineer)
documents.description: Civil structural soundness endorsement confirming floor load-bearing capacity for heavy CNC equipment.

documents.title: Fire Hydrant, Riser & Emergency Evacuation Scheme
documents.description: National Building Code (NBC) Part 4 compliance schematic detailing water storage tank, pump capacity, and escape corridors.

documents.title: Water Balance & Effluent Treatment Plant (ETP) Scheme
documents.description: Mass balance calculations for daily fresh water intake, metal wash recycling loop, and zero liquid discharge (ZLD) specs.

documents.title: Connected Electrical Load Distribution Diagram
documents.description: Single-line electrical diagram (SLD) prepared by a Class-A Electrical Contractor showing transformer & breaker ratings.

documents.title: Factory Shed Building Completion Certificate
documents.description: Architect's certificate confirming construction executed strictly in accordance with sanctioned building plans.

approvals.title: Industrial Plot Allotment Verification
approvals.department: District Industries Centre / Industrial Dev Corp
approvals.statutoryRuleRef: MIDC Industrial Land Disposal Regulations, 1975 - Demo Dataset
inspectionChecklist: Site boundary pillar demarcation confirmed
Road frontage width verification (min. 15m)
Zone classification validation (Industrial General)

approvals.title: Consent to Establish (CTE)
approvals.statutoryRuleRef: Water (Prevention & Control of Pollution) Act 1974, Sec 25 - Demo Dataset
inspectionChecklist: Review distance from nearest natural water body
Air emission stack height specification check
Adequacy of effluent containment trenching

approvals.title: Industrial Building Plan Sanction
approvals.statutoryRuleRef: Standard Unified Development Control Regulations (UDCPR) - Demo Dataset
inspectionChecklist: Ground coverage ratio verification (<50% footprint)
Mandatory front/rear open setback verification
Parking bay calculation against factory workforce

approvals.title: HT Power Load Sanction (150 kVA)
approvals.statutoryRuleRef: Electricity Act 2003, Supply Code Regulations - Demo Dataset
inspectionChecklist: Substation feeder capacity load-flow check
HT metering room location & safety clearance
Earthing pit layout inspection

approvals.title: Provisional Fire NOC
approvals.statutoryRuleRef: Fire Prevention & Life Safety Measures Act, 2006 - Demo Dataset
inspectionChecklist: Fire tender turnaround turning radius (min. 6m)
Underground static water storage tank sizing (100,000L)
Emergency staircase separation & fire doors

approvals.title: Factory Building Plan Approval
approvals.statutoryRuleRef: Factories Act, 1948, Section 6 & State Factory Rules - Demo Dataset
inspectionChecklist: Worker ventilation & cubic space per operator calculation
Emergency exit gangway widths (min. 1.8m)
Sanitary & drinking water facilities headcount ratio
First aid and occupational health post space

approvals.title: Consent to Operate (CTO)
approvals.statutoryRuleRef: Water Act 1974 & Air Act 1981, Sec 21/26 - Demo Dataset
inspectionChecklist: Physical verification of Effluent Treatment Plant (ETP)
Online continuous effluent monitoring system (OCEMS) link
Acoustic enclosure inspection on DG sets
Hazardous waste storage shed concrete flooring

approvals.title: Final Fire Safety Certificate
approvals.statutoryRuleRef: Fire Prevention & Life Safety Rules - Demo Dataset
inspectionChecklist: Live wet riser pressure gauge testing (min. 3.5 bar)
Smoke detector alarm panel trigger test
Fire extinguisher valid hydrostatic test dates
Illuminated exit signage emergency backup battery check

approvals.title: Factory Registration & Operating License
approvals.statutoryRuleRef: Factories Act 1948, Section 6(1) & Form 4 - Demo Dataset
inspectionChecklist: Notice of occupation verification (Form 2)
Machinery safety guard installation inspection
Appointment of qualified safety officer (workforce threshold)
Statutory registers & worker insurance verification

approvals.title: Hazardous Waste Authorization (HWM)
approvals.statutoryRuleRef: Hazardous & Other Wastes Rules, 2016 - Demo Dataset
inspectionChecklist: Designated hazardous waste storage bay inspection (impervious floor)
Disposal agreement with Common HW Management Facility (CHWTSDF)
Manifest system record keeping compliance
